P.name: Love Tap
P.description: {{sbc|Innate:}} '''Miss Fortune's''' {{tip|basic attacks}} are empowered to apply a mark that expires upon attacking a new enemy. If the enemy was unmarked, this also deals {{as|{{pp|key=%|50 to 100 for 6|1;4;7 to 13|formula=50% + 10% every 3 levels up to 7, then + 10% every 2 levels up to 13}} AD}} {{as|'''bonus''' physical damage}}, halved to {{as|{{pp|key=%|50/2 to 100/2 for 6|1;4;7 to 13|formula=25% + 5% every 3 levels up to 7, then + 5% every 2 levels up to 13}} AD}} against {{tip|minion|minions}}.

Q.name: Double Up
Q.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Miss Fortune''' fires a shot at the target enemy that deals {{as|physical damage}} and bounces to hit another enemy behind them, applying {{tip|on-attack}} effects to the primary target and {{tip|on-hit}} effects to both enemies hit.
Q.description2: ''Double Up's'' bounce can {{tip|critically strike}} for{{ft|{{as|{{critical damage|150|50}}|critical damage}} damage.|{{sti|{{as|50% '''bonus''' critical damage}}}}.}}If ''Double Up'' kills the primary target, the bounce will {{tip|critically strike}}.
Q.description3: ''The bounce prioritizes units directly behind the primary target. A target does not have to be {{tip|sight|visible}} to be hit by the bounce.''

W.name: Strut
W.description: {{sbc|Passive:}} '''Miss Fortune''' gains {{sti|ms|{{as|'''bonus''' movement speed}}}} after 4 seconds without taking non-{{tip|persistent damage|periodic}} damage. This bonus is increased after another 3 seconds, and is granted instantly whenever ''Strut'' is cast.
W.leveling:
{{st|Bonus Movement Speed|{{ap|30 to 50}}}}
{{st|Increased Bonus Movement Speed|{{ap|60 to 100}}}}
W.description2: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Miss Fortune''' gains {{sti|as|{{as|'''bonus''' attack speed}}}} for 4 seconds.
W.description3: Marking a new target with ''{{ai|Love Tap|Miss Fortune}}'' reduces ''Strut's'' {{sti|'''current''' cooldown}} by {{tt|2 seconds|Affected by ability haste}}.

E.name: Make It Rain
E.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Miss Fortune''' casts a storm of bullets at the target location for 2 seconds, granting {{tip|sight}} of the area, dealing {{as|magic damage}} every {{fd|0.25}} seconds to enemies within, and {{tip|slow|slowing}} them by 40% {{as|(+ 6% per 100 AP)}}.
E.leveling: {{st|Magic Damage Per Tick|{{ap|70/8 to 190/8}} {{as|(+ {{ap|120/8}}% AP)}}|Total Magic Damage|{{ap|70 to 190}} {{as|(+ 120% AP)}}}}

R.name: Bullet Time
R.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Miss Fortune''' {{tip|channel|channels}} for up to 3 seconds, firing a number of waves of bullets in the target direction. Each wave is in a spread of 6 projectiles that deals {{as|physical damage}} to enemies hit.
R.leveling:
{{st|Physical Damage per Wave|{{ap|20 to 40}} {{as|(+ 60% AD)}} {{as|(+ 25% AP)}}}}
{{st|Total Waves|{{ap|14 to 18}}|Maximum Total Physical Damage|{{ap|20*14 to 40*18}} {{as|(+ {{ap|60*14 to 60*18}}% AD)}} {{as|(+ {{ap|25*14 to 25*18}}% AP)}}}} {{st|Wave Interval Time|{{ap|2.85/(14 to 18)|round=4}} seconds}}
